text: Welcome to Cedar Study Centre. There is an information desk beside the entrance. There are two study rooms. Each room has three computers. Students bring a university card when they use a computer. Please bring your card, not a passport.
I need six notebooks for the workshop. Sorry, that is not correct. I need three notebooks, not six. Please add two folders and one dictionary. The folders should be green. The dictionary can be blue.

The short workshop is on Wednesday, not Monday. It starts at ten in the morning and lasts one hour. We provide notebooks. Please bring your own pen and your university card. The workshop is in the first study room.
